title: OpenChoreo ComponentType
description: Defines how different application types deploy. Platform Engineers create ComponentTypes to provide templates for developers.

workloadType.description: Type of Kubernetes workload to create. Determines the base resource template.

allowedWorkflows.description: Optional list of allowed build workflows for this component type

name.description: Name of an allowed Workflow resource

allowedTraits.description: Optional list of allowed traits for this component type

name.description: Name of an allowed Trait resource

schema.description: Schema definitions for developer-facing parameters and PE-controlled overrides

types.description: Reusable type definitions referenced by parameters and envOverrides

parameters.description: Developer-facing configuration parameters. Values use schema DSL format: "type | constraint=value"

resources.description: Kubernetes resource templates to generate. Uses CEL expressions for dynamic values.

id.description: Unique identifier for this resource template. For the primary resource, must match workloadType.

includeWhen.description: CEL expression that determines whether to include this resource. Empty = always include.

forEach.description: CEL expression that returns a list to iterate over, generating one resource per item.

var.description: Variable name for the current item when using forEach.

template.description: Kubernetes resource template with CEL expressions in ${...} blocks
